hero.lead: Screener maintains live order books for <mono>500+</mono> spot and futures tickers across <mono>20+</mono> crypto exchanges, classifies every price level against your own thresholds, and streams the result to you in under a second.

pricing.subtitle: Every plan includes the full product. The only difference is duration and price.

pricing.footnote: all plans · 500+ tickers · custom rules · charts · oi alerts · voice notifications

features.title: Your thresholds. Your tickers. Sub-second.
features.subtitle: A high-throughput engine watches the market so you don't have to — and tells you, out loud, when something matters.

liveBooks.label: Live order books
liveBooks.body: Real-time local books for 500+ spot and futures tickers across 20+ exchanges, streamed over WebSockets in under a second.

rules.label: Rules you define
rules.body: Set custom classification thresholds per ticker. Levels are ranked by proximity to the spread and notional value — significance on your terms, not ours.

charts.label: Charts
charts.body: Volume-change charts for every ticker on every exchange, plus candlestick data — see where activity is building before the move.

oiAlerts.label: Open interest alerts
oiAlerts.body: When a ticker's open interest grows unusually large, you're notified the moment it happens — not an hour later.

voice.label: Voice notifications
voice.body: Alerts are read out loud with text-to-speech. Watch the market without watching the screen.

volume.label: Built for volume
volume.body: Engineered for hundreds of thousands of book updates per second. No queues, no sampling, no lag — the number you see is the market now.

cta.title: Start with {{days}} days free.
cta.subtitle: No card needed. Full access from the first minute.
